title: fix(components,plugin-view): date / datetime list filters draw the platform date picker (objectui#12743)
body:
Fixes #12743
Clause-②: no — measured correction of the claim's provisional `yes`. No export, prop, type member, dependency or language-pack key is added or removed. `@object-ui/components` still does not import `@object-ui/fields`, and `@object-ui/plugin-view` gains no dependency. Both filter UIs resolve the `field:date` / `field:datetime` widget that `@object-ui/fields` already registers in `ComponentRegistry`, the way the form renderer in `@object-ui/components` already resolves `field:TYPE`. The value each filter writes keeps its shape.

Half 2 of objectui#12664's triage scope (`6216283515`). Half 1 (the grid cell seam) landed as `d66d7e8`.

## What changed

1. **`FilterBuilder` (`packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`).** A `date` / `datetime` row, scalar and both `between` bounds, draws the widget the host registered as `field:date` / `field:datetime` (`registeredTemporalWidget`, read at render time). A new module-private `TemporalValueEditor` renders it:
   - inside its own `Suspense`, with a placeholder that holds no input (the widget arrives lazily);
   - with a visually hidden label for the box's name (`Value`, or `From` / `To` on the bounds). The picker's placeholder is the locale pattern;
   - writes the row's existing shape: `YYYY-MM-DD` for date. For datetime, the picker's ISO instant is read back onto the zoneless local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` that `datetime-local` wrote. It uses `toDateTimeInputValue` from `@object-ui/core`, the adapter the picker reads with;
   - a pointer press outside the editor while it holds focus blurs it first (a capture listener, the seam `DataTable` uses for injected cell editors). The picker's commit-on-blur therefore reads the typed text before a host popover or drawer closes. Escape does not blur: it discards.
   - With nothing registered (no `@object-ui/fields` loaded), the row keeps the native input, as the form does. `time` rows are unchanged.
2. **`FilterUI` (`packages/plugin-view/src/FilterUI.tsx`).** The `date` filter and both `date-range` bounds take the same route (`DateFilterInput`: `field:date` from the registry, its own `Suspense`, the same outside-press blur). The value stays `YYYY-MM-DD`; the native input stays when nothing is registered.
3. **Changeset** `.changeset/12743-filter-date-picker.md`: `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-view`, patch.

## Measured at start (PM assumption A1)

- **Which filter UI the console's list renders.** `plugin-list`'s `ListView` toolbar Filter panel renders `FilterBuilder` from `@object-ui/components` (`extraOperators={LIST_VIEW_EXTRA_OPERATORS}`). `components/src/renderers/complex/filter-builder.tsx` is the SDUI `filter-builder` node renderer around the same component, so it needed no edit. `plugin-view`'s `FilterUI` is the SDUI `filter-ui` block. A grep of `apps/console`, `app-shell` and `plugin-list` for `filter-ui` / `FilterUI` found no renderer of it: it is reached only through authored nodes (docs, the schema catalog).
- **How each drew its value input.** `FilterBuilder` used `Input type={FILTER_INPUT_TYPE_BY_FAMILY[...]}`: `date`, `datetime-local` and `time`. The `between` bounds used the same. `FilterUI` used `Input type="date"`.
- **A1, as worded, was false.** Neither builder resolved its value editors through a registry. The registry seam the ruling prefers already exists, though: `registerAllFields()` registers `field:date` / `field:datetime` as `withFieldCarrier(React.lazy(loader))`, the loaders `import()` the `fields-date-picker` chunk, and `@object-ui/fields` runs it on import. The form renderer in the same package (`renderFieldComponent`) resolves `field:TYPE` from it. So the preferred route needed no new export, prop or dependency. The ruling's fallbacks (a) and (b) were not needed.

## Tests (A2)

New pins:
- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.filterDatePicker-12743.test.tsx` runs on the real console path, `ListView` toolbar → `FilterBuilder`, with `registerAllFields()`. Only the data source is faked. It pins:
  - (a) the picker face and no `input[type=date]` (`en`: `MM/DD/YYYY`, `10/01/2026`); a `zh` session gives `YYYY/MM/DD` / `2026/10/01`;
  - (b) a typed `10/20/2026` is applied as `2026-10-20` on Enter, on blur, and on a press outside the panel (pointerdown + click; the panel closes);
  - (c) a datetime row shows `10/01/2026, 09:15 AM` and writes `2026-10-20T14:30` from a typed `10/20/2026 14:30`;
  - (d) CONTROL: text and number rows still draw `type=text` / `type=number`.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-date-value-seam-12743.test.tsx` tests the seam with a commit-on-blur stand-in widget, because `components` cannot import `fields`. It pins the scalar and `between` faces, blur, Enter, an outside press, an inside press that does not blur, Escape discarding, the datetime shape, and two CONTROLs: text/number rows, and no registration keeping the native input.
- `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/FilterUI.datePicker-12743.test.tsx` covers `date` and `date-range`, blur and outside press, plus a CONTROL (the text filter, and the native input with no registration).
- (e) CONTROL, eager closure: `pnpm check:eager-closure` on a console `vite build` of this branch exits 0 and prints `packages/fields 88 modules in ui-components and its src/widgets/date-picker subtree 2 in fields-date-picker, exactly`. `dist/eager-closure.json` does not name `fields-date-picker`.

**Ablations.** Each leg ran at HEAD `3fc88bff0` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from the objectstack checkout: the anchor was x1 before and x0 after, and each leg was restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. Vitest aliases `@object-ui/components` to `src`, so no dist step was needed.
- A, the wiring (`registeredTemporalWidget` returns `undefined`; blob `3d6f94a` → `868ba46`): **14 failed | 3 passed**. Every (a)/(b)/(c) pin in both files went red; the three CONTROLs stayed green.
- B, the outside-press blur (`focused.blur()` → `void focused`; blob → `9459827`): **2 failed | 15 passed**: the ListView outside-press pin and the seam outside-press pin.
- C, the `FilterUI` wiring (`ComponentRegistry.get('date', 'field')` → `undefined`; blob `12e4922` → `4811b31`): **2 failed | 1 passed**.

**Runs.** Each run used `--maxWorkers=1` under the verify lock, with the tree at `3fc88bff0` or an earlier commit of this branch whose files the later commits did not change:
- the three new files: 7 + 10 + 3 passed;
- every `packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder*` file plus `examples/schema-catalog/test/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.tsx`: 20 files / 417 tests passed;
- the components tests naming `FilterBuilder` / `config-field-renderer`: 4 files / 26 passed;
- the `plugin-list` tests that open the Filter panel or hold `initialFilters`: 13 files / 95 passed;
- `packages/plugin-view/` whole dir: 79 files / 723 tests passed.

NOT MEASURED: the whole-package run of `packages/components/`. It hit its 1500s timeout (exit 124), so the targeted sets above are declared in its place and CI runs the full farm. NOT MEASURED: a real-browser screenshot (no backend booted).

## Gates (local)

- Closure builds `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-view^...' build` and `--filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' build` (which rebuilds components with this change): exit 0.
- `type-check`: components 0, plugin-view 0, plugin-list 0. Each package's `tsconfig.test.json` globs `src/**/*.test.tsx`.
- eslint `--no-inline-config`, narrowed to the 5 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (the population is the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block; the JSON format counted 5 files). Result: 0 errors. The two sources carry the same warning counts as their BASE blobs (20 and 7). The config has no `project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- The pre-tsc battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, and `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`.
- Also exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:eager-closure`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured: why the outside-press blur is there.** Radix's popover defers its outside dismissal to the `click` that follows a primary-button pointerdown (`deferPointerDownOutside`). In a browser, the mousedown between them moves focus and already blurs the picker. The capture listener makes the commit independent of how a host dismisses: a drawer, another popover version, or a host that unmounts on pointerdown. Ablation B shows it is what carries the commit when nothing else moves focus.
- **The incomplete-range marker on a picker bound** reaches the widget as `error`, which drives its `aria-invalid`. `aria-describedby` is not in the field widget's DOM pass-through list (`toDomProps`), so the visible "is required" line is not linked to the picker's box as it is to the native input's. The native path is unchanged and its pins still pass.
- **Not covered here:** the user-filter chips in `plugin-list` (`UserFilters.tsx`) draw a native `type="date"` pair for a date range. That file is outside this claim's surface. It was read from source only and not reproduced. It is reported to the seat, not built here.
- The record details inline editor is objectui#12759 and is not touched here.
